system.description:
Action
Main Action
SP
4
Attribute
Automatic
Range
One open space within 3 squares
Duration
1 minute, with commands

Manifest a serpentine storm-dragon using the Storm Column summoned profile. Its shape expresses the spell; use that profile's movement, attacks and defenses. Give one immediate Main command, then normal commands and the six-square tether.
